tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the Charter Hall exhibit path, stopping at each charter panel and narrating mission content.
tasks.terrain: Smooth indoor exhibit floor; avoid display plinths and queued visitors in the 28-building block context.
success: Visits all 5 charter panels within 15 min
Keeps <=0.3 m lateral error from waypoint path
Speech utterance triggered at each panel
Zero collisions recorded
safety_stops: E-stop on torso contact >5 N
Stop if a human is within 0.5 m ahead
Abort tour if battery <20%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the tour script content before public delivery.

tasks.goal: Drive the riverside track near Pont du Gard to build an elevation map of the 95.6 m relief gorge for the evidence base.
tasks.terrain: Dirt and scrub riverside track; 95.6 m relief slopes, loose sand patches (5 sand features), garrigue scrub (19).
success: Maps >=800 m of track in one sortie
Elevation map RMS error <0.15 m vs GNSS checkpoints
No tip events (roll <10 deg)
Returns to start within 2 m
safety_stops: Stop on roll >10 deg or pitch >20 deg
Stop within 1 m of waterline polygon
E-stop on wheel slip >30% for 3 s
tasks.human_in_loop: Operator confirms route corridor along the riverbank before launch.

tasks.goal: Inspect the lower tier arches and piers of the Pont du Gard masonry, flagging cracks and vegetation growth for stewards.
tasks.terrain: Irregular limestone blocks, arch ledges, sand/gravel banks of the Gardon; wet rock near the 3 water features.
success: Captures images of >=6 arch piers at <1 m range
Crack detection precision >=0.8 on labeled test set
Body pose stays within 0.2 m of structure face
No falls (z drop >0.3 m)
safety_stops: Stop if distance to structure <0.2 m
Recall if z-drop >0.3 m detected
Abort on IMU impact >4 g
Abort if water detected below within 1 m during stance change
tasks.human_in_loop: A heritage steward approves final inspection points and receives flagged defects.

tasks.goal: Fly a perimeter scan of the open forum court to produce an overhead layout image for proposal placard placement.
tasks.terrain: Open air above mixed park (37 park features) and tree canopy (69 trees); gusts funneled by the gorge.
success: Completes 4-corner perimeter at 8 m altitude in <6 min
Position error <0.5 m at each corner
Single contiguous orthomosaic with >=80% overlap
Battery reserve >15% at landing
safety_stops: Land immediately if position error >1 m for 2 s
Avoid tree canopy by 2 m vertical buffer
Return-to-launch on battery <25%
Kill motors on prop contact detection
tasks.human_in_loop: A person approves the flight plan and confirms the airspace is clear.

tasks.goal: Restock task-routing bins: pick routed task cards from supply pallet and place them into labeled working-group slots.
tasks.terrain: Indoor deck with pallet racking; obstacles are bin dividers and cable runs on the console floor.
success: Picks 12 cards with >=95% success rate
Places each within 0.02 m of slot center
Contact force <10 N on placement
Cycle time <15 s per card
safety_stops: Stop on wrench >20 N or 5 Nm
Pause if a human enters the 1.5 m collaborative zone
Halt on gripper slip detection
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator verifies slot assignments before each restock batch runs.

tasks.goal: Walk between observatory stations and calibrate progress displays by pressing panel keys and reading gauge screens.
tasks.terrain: Flat observatory floor with console steps; ensure stair-safe footing near the 0.3 m display risers.
success: Reaches 4 stations with <0.15 m positioning error
Gauge readback OCR accuracy >=95%
Zero falls; both foot contacts confirmed each step
Completes circuit in <20 min
safety_stops: Squat-stop if CoM offset >0.1 m from support polygon
Freeze on human within 1 m
Power down on foot contact sensor mismatch >0.5 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms calibration values read from the gauges before logging.

tasks.goal: Collect vegetation and soil observation transects through Bois communal de Remoulins scrub for the evidence monitor.
tasks.terrain: Mediterranean scrub (19 scrub, 24 wood features), sandy patches, low tree branches from 69-tree canopy, 95.6 m relief slopes.
success: Completes 6 transect points with soil probe readings
Head camera captures 360 deg panorama at each point
No snag events on vegetation
Battery >20% at extraction
safety_stops: Stop if branch detected <0.3 m above head
Stop on tilt >12 deg
E-stop on track jam torque >150% rated
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher approves transect point selection before deployment.

tasks.goal: Shelve archived charter documents: retrieve folders from intake tray and place them precisely on archive shelf slots.
tasks.terrain: Indoor archive room with tight 0.4 m shelf gaps; obstacle is the shelf lip and neighboring folder spines.
success: Places 10 folders within 0.01 m of slot target
Zero vacuum-release drops
Wrench <8 N during insertion
Cycle time <20 s per folder
safety_stops: Retract on wrench >15 N
Pause if human hand detected in workspace
Stop on gripper vacuum loss mid-transfer
tasks.human_in_loop: An archivist approves shelf layout and handles any misfiled folder.
